title: CISA Adds SolarWinds Serv-U CVE-2026-28318 to KEV — Unauthenticated DoS, 12,000+ Servers Exposed

CVE-2026-28318.evidence: osed CISA added **CVE-2026-28318** (uncontrolled resource consumption) to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on June 5, confirming active exploitation targeting SolarWinds Serv-U file transfer servers.

CVE-2021-35211.evidence: The Clop ransomware gang previously exploited Serv-U RCE (CVE-2021-35211) in 2021; Chinese state-sponsored DEV-0322 also weaponized it in zero-day attacks.
